answer: Each new identity must lock a 4 POA bond in a harbor contract for 60 epochs, and the bond price rises 1 POA per 10 accounts sharing one funding source, so a cluster of n fakes costs roughly 4n plus n squared over ten. Reaching the zenith of reputation needs 5 independent vouchers, and auditors sample 3 random accounts per epoch, slashing 50% of any bond tied to marble-identical behavior logs.
